crossRefs.note: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.
translations.bsb: And the men of Israel went out to fight against Benjamin and took up their battle positions at Gibeah.
translations.kjv: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
translations.asv: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.
